meta.aciklama:
A solo developer turned Claude Code into a 49-agent game studio. Comment "GODOT" and I'll send you the setup guide.

49 agents, 70+ skills, three tiers: directors, department leads, specialists. You pitch the game with /start, they ask questions and wait for your yes.

The twist: in the repo's own test, the build that wrote 30 documents before any code was ranked last. Stay on minimal rigor.

Free and open source, works with Godot, Unity and Unreal. Heads up: it needs a paid Claude plan and burns tokens. Repo by @Donchitos on GitHub.

#claudecode #indiedev #godot #aiagents #gamedev

transkript.t: One developer in Melbourne turned Claude Code
into a 49 agent game studio,
and over 31,000 people started.
Picture a whole studio, directors, programmers,
sound designers, and QA testers in one folder.
Each agent is a prompt file.
You type slash start, pitch your game,
and the directors handwork down the chain one at a time.
Nothing gets written without your yes.
One team built a working Android prototype
in four days on a standard plan, but here's the twist.
In his own test, the version that wrote 30 documents
before any code ranked last with two blind reviewers
and a play test.
So the default is minimal.
A one-page brief, build, then launch the game
and look at it.
Heads up, it needs a paid Claude plan
and burns tokens fast.
Comment Godot and I'll send you the install steps,
the first prompt, and the settings that save tokens.
